description: This file defines the FileChooser class, which provides an interface to handle file input dialogs in a web page context. It includes methods to access the element handle, check if multiple files are allowed, get the associated page, and set files for upload.

classes.name: FileChooser
classes.description: Represents a file selection dialog, allowing files to be set for input elements on a web page.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the element handle associated with the file chooser.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Indicates whether multiple files can be selected.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page instance associated with the file chooser.

methods.name: setFiles
methods.description: Sets the files for the input element, accepting various formats and optional timeout and behavior options.
